customManagers.description: Version pins held in a Dockerfile ARG, annotated with a `# renovate:` comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates automerge once every check passes. ghcr.io publishes no release timestamps, so those are not held forever.
Exception: on 0.x a minor bump can break, so it needs a human.
Upgrades migrate stored data one way, so a bad release cannot simply be rolled back. Needs a human.
